description: Get the next acceptance criterion to work on for the given project, plus the other ready criteria of the same story (`bundle`) so the whole story can be built together. When nothing can be claimed, `criterion` is null and `reason` says why (for example awaiting approval, awaiting review, failed and needing rework, blocked, or everything passed), with `blocking` listing the criteria behind it. `skipped_sprints` lists earlier sprints that still have leftovers waiting on a person or CI. Pass releaseId to scope the answer to one release.

releaseId.description: Optional release UUID; defaults to the project's active release

name: vibemap_get_next_ready_criterion
